Answer: Education & Reference is more common than Entertainment & Music

The file has 1,676 questions and no labels, so I couldn't count the labels directly. I used regex keyword lists as a rough proxy for each category. They matched 222 questions for Education & Reference and 95 for Entertainment & Music. The gap is large, so I think the direction is probably right. The keyword lists are crude, though, so the direction is not certain.
